title: KernelChain config
description:
Spec 19 §KernelComposer + spec 22 §Catalog schema. A biome's `kernel` field is either a single-stage kernel spec (flat object with `type` + `params`) OR a chain spec (`type: 'chain'` + ordered `stages` array of single-stage specs).

KernelComposer reads this when baking a world; runs the stages in order (output of stage N is input to stage N+1). Currently shipping stage types: `noise_stack` (base height field) + `erosion` (post-process). A bare single-stage spec is treated as a chain-of-one.

Multi-biome blending is NOT inside the chain — it happens at the Composer level across biomes via auto_biome_rules softmax.

type.description: Stage kernel type. `noise_stack` is a base generator (produces height from x,z); `erosion` is a post-process (takes height in, returns eroded height + auxiliary fields).

params.description: Stage-specific parameters. Validated against the per-stage schema (noise_stack.schema.json or erosion.schema.json) at composer-load time.

stages.description: Ordered list of single-stage specs. Output of stage N is input to stage N+1. First stage MUST be a base generator (noise_stack); subsequent stages MAY be post-processes (erosion). max 8 stages keeps bake-time bounded.
